resources.string: Check or install language packs here.
Google’s on-device translator needs a pack for each non-English language. English is included. These packs are separate from other downloaded translation models.
Choose different languages supported by ML Kit.
The target language pack is installed. Other detected speech languages may need another pack.
With automatic speech detection, also install packs for any other languages you expect to hear.
Downloading %1$s… waiting for Wi-Fi if needed.
